verdict.rationale: The OpenHands CLI documents an 'Auto-approve all actions' option, which implies a default confirmation mode plus an all-or-nothing bypass. That is a native approval control, but it shows only a binary switch, not tiered levels. Missing for 10: documented multiple autonomy tiers, per-action or risk-based rules for what runs without confirmation, team or admin-level policy configuration for an engineering lead, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation
